model-binding.text: The Lean model is unchanged. A fold of one request equals a single step, the windows follow the request phase, and the chain's exclusive upper bound is why the built bound may equal the deadline slot.

decisions.text: The combined form stays only on request. The fold reads an insertion's envelope from a hash-keyed store in the registry directory. A fold takes one request. Time is the deadline's authority and a slot is never estimated. A fast guard is followed by a check of the built bound. Reject and reclaim judge their windows on the node's own view, and refunds are bound to node reads.

slices.text: Booking and fold come first, then reject, then reclaim, then a recovery control for a fold by another wallet. Each is one reviewed change in its own pull request.

verification.text: Continuous integration on each exact head runs the unit suite, the Demo 1 journey from the release archive, the controls, the flags check and the full lint and documentation checks.
